summary.text: Matt Lehman is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 79 who has represented the district since 2008 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an insurance agent and has served as House majority leader since 2016.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Ian Richardson, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Lehman earned an associate degree from Vincennes University in 1984.
His professional experience includes working as a partner with Bixler Insurance Incorporated and as an insurance agent.
He was first elected to the Indiana House in 2008 and was selected as House majority leader on October 6, 2015, taking on the role in the January 2016 session.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Commerce, Small Business and Economic Development Committee, the Insurance committee and the House Public Policy Committee.
